resource_baseline.registered_gates_hold_here: R2 zero >=50 ms observations passes on all budgeted workloads (hedged max 48.61); R4 peak RSS <=845 MB passes (max 661.9). No gate amendment required for this environment.
resource_baseline.candidate_activation_message_rule: After each asset's final hash, use its lexically first valid retained mapping to instantiate the concrete activation message; freeze the message before any score result (V6 P5).

A_blind_aliases.build_input: Catalog-only: the 1,115 coarse shelf labels and canonical final/head tokens, deduplicated; per head the canonical head plus at most five catalog shelf-name contexts. No products, IDs, evaluator messages, axis vocabulary, result files, or source code.

generation_contract.classes: synonyms, regional/common-usage variants, one-level hypernyms only
generation_contract.excluded: brands, materials, colors, use cases, product attributes, aliases copied from repository tests or measurements

A_blind_aliases.collision_rules: drop empty/stopword-only/canonical-identical; one head retains; two heads retain both (hedged); more than two heads drops; exact name of a different canonical shelf/head drops
A_blind_aliases.audit: outcome-blind stratified sample >=200 retained mappings (or all) reviewed by the MNN engineer; removal only for documented semantic error before final hash; eligibility observed supported-head-family precision >=0.98 with Wilson lower bound >=0.95; model review labelled 'independent model review', never human validation
A_blind_aliases.blocked_if: no clean generator is available; hand-authoring from development misses is forbidden

B_catalog_only_mnn.input_fields: title, features, details, category text only; document presence, not term frequency; no Catalog.tf / Catalog.corpus
B_catalog_only_mnn.formula: c(w,b) = products in shelf b containing w; v_w[b] = c(w,b)/|b|; v_h identically for head h; L2-normalized cosine(w,h)
B_catalog_only_mnn.ambiguity: two reciprocal heads emit both; more than two emit nothing; catalog-absent terms emit nothing
B_catalog_only_mnn.audit: same stratified supported-shelf precision review by the alias engineer; accept/reject only, no manual mapping removal

candidates.shared_serving_contract: exact_bucket first; exact success returns baseline untouched with zero transform lookups; otherwise baseline resolve/route unchanged, longest normalized alias span (ties: rightmost, then lexical key), replace span with each canonical head alternative preserving residual tokens, _overlap_ranked per transformed phrase, unweighted RRF merge with lexical tie-break, at most two shelves absent from the baseline pool, appended before state.rejection.filter after fuse_global; baseline pre-filter pool remains an ordered prefix; no score/feature bonus; primary/hedge/clarification/boost/reranker/scorer/route widths/commit policy unchanged
candidates.mode_switch: P_SHELF_TRANSFORM=off|aliases|mnn; invalid values or missing/corrupt assets fail closed to off

registration_addendum_B.B1_head_eligibility_filter: Identical for both candidates, applied to build input before generation/MNN. Ineligible: numeric/currency/4-digit-year/^v\d+$ normalized forms; all-uppercase surface longer than one character; stopwords or single characters; shelf label matching promotional-banner patterns (percent sign, or off/savings/deals/prime/exclusives/sale/new arrivals/essentials/top rated/best seller/under $N case-insensitive on the whole label); total catalog products across shelves sharing the normalized head < 10. Manifest records the frozen pattern list and per-rule exclusion counts.
registration_addendum_B.B2_min_shelf_size_candidate_B: Shelves with fewer than 10 products contribute no coordinate to any v_w/v_h vector; after exclusion a term still needs document frequency >= 5 among retained shelves. Synthetic control B9: 3-product-shelf concentration maps nowhere, 30-product-shelf concentration maps.
registration_addendum_B.B3_miss_taxonomy_fields: Per bucket: scenario type (buying/browsing/intent_override/boundary) and failing phrase component (head-only / modifier-only / both / neither). STOP-3 additionally requires >=3 shelf-resolution misses attributable to the head/final component (alone or within 'both').
registration_addendum_B.B4_stop3_at_three: Exactly three qualifying misses PASSES; the artifact states the count, the base of six, the Wilson interval, and the limitation that a base of six cannot distinguish half the loss from a quarter; no downstream gate changes.
registration_addendum_B.B5_scenario_stratified_reporting: v6_dev_comparison.json additionally reports turn-1 pool recall and fixed-width category TechnicalScore by scenario; descriptive only, no gate, no Holm member, no selection input.

metrics.primary_mechanism: absolute paired delta in category turn-1 pool recall
secondary: pool p50/p95 and full-catalog fallback frequency
HR@10 given ever-pool plus actual conditional MRR/rank
supported-head-family precision from the outcome-blind audit

bootstrap.unit: conversation (paired by session; variants averaged within session)
bootstrap.reports: observed delta, bootstrap median, one-sided 95% lower bound for improvement claims, two-sided 95% for descriptive tables, improved/worsened/tied counts, exact McNemar for binary recall

statistics.multiplicity: Holm correction across Alias-vs-baseline and MNN-vs-baseline, separately for the V6-D3 recall claim and the V6-D6 fixed-width score claim
statistics.vocabulary_sensitivity: primary interval recomputed clustered by normalized rewritten shelf/head family; sensitivity, not a second chance

development.V6-D2: no baseline pool member lost for an identical state
development.V6-D3: category turn-1 pool recall >= +0.030 absolute AND paired one-sided 95% lower bound > 0
development.V6-D4: category ever recall >= 0.970, or +0.030 over the Phase 1 rebased baseline
development.V6-D6: fixed-width category TechnicalScore delta lower bound > 0
development.V6-D7: normal-width category TechnicalScore point delta > 0 and lower bound >= -0.005
development.V6-D8: audit precision observed >= 0.98, Wilson lower bound >= 0.95

noninferiority.N4: no increase in full-catalog fallback frequency
noninferiority.N5: pool p95 <= 1.25x baseline; report p50 and max
noninferiority.N6: shadow clean point delta >= -0.005, no new failure class
noninferiority.N7: fixed-width and normal-width conclusions agree in sign or decline

resource.R1: fresh processes, 3 warmups, 299 serial turns per budgeted workload; candidate workloads record mode/asset hash and nonzero activation
resource.R2: zero observations >= 50 ms on every budgeted workload
resource.R5: report construction time, asset bytes, checksum cost

confirmation.C1: positive turn-1 recall and fixed-width category point deltas on dev and sealed confirmation
confirmation.C5: clean full public transcript and score exact

selection_rule: Disqualify any candidate failing any V6-D/N/R/provenance gate; none qualify -> decline; one qualifies -> winner; both qualify -> larger lower confidence bound for fixed-width category TechnicalScore; head-to-head interval includes zero or bounds differ by <0.005 -> tied, choose smaller asset bytes then lower activation latency; never combine

sealed_validation.S1: sealed lexical-shift confirmation instrument over sessions 101-200, deterministic, catalog-labels plus generic templates only; consumed exactly once by the selected winner; prior exposure acknowledged
sealed_validation.S2: target-free shelf-language audit: 120 natural shopper phrases over 60 catalog-only strata families with acceptable canonical head/shelf sets; builders never read it; 11 no-mapping families test ambiguous-query coverage
sealed_validation.generator_separation: validation author is not the alias generator; same-family isolation is recorded as 'process-disjoint, not family-disjoint'
sealed_validation.ledger: analysis/v6_validation_ledger.json, append-only, keyed by validation-set hash plus complete frozen candidate hash; a consumed or mismatched set blocks the cycle
